Title: LinkedIn Learning and Schoox Deep Integration Guide

Blocks.Text:
Authentication: SSO
Content Discovery: Automatic Content Sync (All languages)
Reporting: AICC

Requirements:
The LinkedIn Learning and Schoox integration involves the following requirements:

An active Schoox LMS instance
An active LinkedIn Learning account
Admin access to LinkedIn Learning
Admin privileges to your Schoox LMS instance

LinkedIn Learning supports SAML-based Single Sign-On (SSO) for enterprise integrations. Most organizations already use a centralized identity provider like Azure AD, Okta or ADFS to manage user authentication across business applications.

By enabling SSO, learners can seamlessly access LinkedIn Learning using their existing organizational credentials, eliminating the need to remember additional usernames or passwords and allowing them to focus on learning.
The LinkedIn Learning library contains thousands of courses. LinkedIn Learning adds courses at a rate of 20-30 per week at no extra cost.

The Schoox deep integration with LinkedIn Learning uses LinkedIn Learning APIs to refresh the content library daily. This feature ensures LinkedIn Learning makes new content available within 24 hours of release.

LinkedIn Learning captures all content viewed on its platform in robust usage reports accessible from the LinkedIn Learning administrative interface. In addition to generating reports, LinkedIn Learning uses AICC to communicate a learner’s progress back to Schoox when the learner launches content from the LMS.
Enabling SAML SSO

LinkedIn Learning recommends SAML SSO for all enterprise learning platform integrations. SSO authentication is configured in the LinkedIn Learning Admin settings, where integration with an organization’s identity provider (such as Azure AD, Okta, or ADFS) enables secure user authentication.

To configure SAML SSO with your identity management solution, share the LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide with your organization’s IT team.

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text: To sync your Schoox content with LinkedIn Learning, take the following steps:

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text:
Login to LinkedIn Learning. If you are not already in the Admin screen, select Navigate to Admin, then select Settings > Integration


From the side navigation menu, Access content and reports via API.

Click the down arrow on the right to expand the Generate LinkedIn Learning REST API Application section.

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text:
Click Add Application and provide the name related to your LMS (e.g. "Schoox LMS Integration"), as the application name, and provide a short description of the integration use case in the application description field.





There are two checkboxes – Content and Report. Select the fields that apply to you. For Content Sync to the LMS, only Content is required.

Click Next and agree to the Terms and Conditions

Save the Client ID and Client Secret values.

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text: These values will be inputted into your Schoox system to enable the content sync between LinkedIn Learning and Schoox

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: Check out the LinkedIn Learning AICC configuration workflow

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: Note

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: For courses to launch and to communicate learner activity back to Schoox, you must enable AICC in your LinkedIn Learning admin settings.

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: To enable AICC in LinkedIn Learning, take the following steps:

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: After you login to LinkedIn Learning. If you are not already in the Admin screen, select Navigate to Admin, then select Settings > Integration

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text:
From the side navigation menu, select Add content to your LMS.

Expand the Configure AICC section.

Click Add Hostname(s).

In the Hostname name field, enter the hostname provided by Schoox such as "company.schoox.com".

Select On to enable the AICC integration.

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Schoox
Blocks.Text: To complete the configuration with Schoox, you need the following information:

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Schoox
Blocks.Text: • Client ID

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Schoox
Blocks.Text: • Client Secret

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Schoox
Blocks.Text: Once you’ve gathered the required information and have logged into the Schoox LMS, follow these steps below:

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Schoox
Blocks.Text:
In Schoox, on the LinkedIn Learning panel, enter the Client ID and Client Secret to import the content.





In the course Catalog the LinkedIn Learning provider can be selected to view content.





Course settings can be configured as required.

Blocks.Text: Congratulations! Your learners now can access LinkedIn Learning content and reporting via their Schoox instance.
